statements.text: The cosmic background field can be read as strictly a field of consciousness, on an idealist reading, or as the carrier of both primordial energy and primordial consciousness, on a dual-aspect reading. The 2018 proposal stays agnostic, and the 2020 paper adopts the dual-aspect reading while suggesting that consciousness may turn out to be the intrinsic force behind physics.
